task: Predict PTEN mutation status in endometrial carcinoma. Classes: negative vs. positive. On H&E, PTEN-mutant tumors are often low-grade endometrioid carcinomas with glandular architecture and relatively bland cytology, whereas negative tumors may lack this classic pattern.

classes.0: PTEN-negative endometrial carcinoma lacking the typical low-grade gland-forming endometrioid pattern associated with PTEN alteration.
classes.1: PTEN-positive endometrial carcinoma with low-grade endometrioid morphology, glandular architecture, and relatively bland nuclei.
